about: Example requests, keyed by tool name. Read by app/phrases.py for the 'What can I say?' panel and for the hints shown when a step is not run. 'quick' is read by the page itself: the short requests shown on the starting screen (an entry whose 'tool' is not in the catalogue is left out). A tool that is not listed here is shown with its catalogue description instead; an entry whose tool is not in the catalogue is ignored. Every example writes each value it needs (the model copies values from the text and never computes them). 'label' is how the tool is named in a sentence; 'ask' says how to ask for a missing argument.

sketch.title: Draw a sketch
sketch.note: Start a sketch, then draw in it. Sizes are in mm.

feature.title: Shape the part
feature.note: Turn a sketch into a solid, then add holes, rounded edges and patterns.

body.title: Whole bodies
body.note: Make a simple solid in one step, or move, copy and change the body.

document.title: Files
document.note: New, open and save ask you first.
